name: pom-probe
description: Scene-graph probe (SwiftShader-ok): confirms buildPomFloorMaterial is actually applied to the floor meshes at Maximum with pomFloors on — logs per-floor-mesh material.userData.pomHeightMap + customProgramCacheKey. Use floor-tile-grey (procedural, POM-eligible — NOT floor-tile-white, which is DLC-shadowed to a textured Poly Haven photo and never hits the POM path).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: probe
steps.eval: (function(){ const st=window.__store.getState(); const scene=window.__three.scene; let pom=0,total=0,keys={}; scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh && o.userData && o.userData.finishTarget && o.userData.finishTarget.kind==='floor'){ total++; const m=o.material; if(m&&m.userData&&m.userData.pomHeightMap){ pom++; const k=m.customProgramCacheKey?m.customProgramCacheKey():'?'; keys[k]=(keys[k]||0)+1; } } }); console.log('POMPROBE tier='+st.qualityTier+' pomFloors='+st.featureFlags.pomFloors+' floorMeshes='+total+' withPOM='+pom+' keys='+JSON.stringify(keys)); })()
